requirements.quote: Core migration domain on top of packages/core/src/import (upload portfolio file, column mapping, dry-run reporting mapping issues for 5,000 matters without writing, resumable chunked import with progress, rollback via undoImportBatch)
Acceptance: dry-run of 5,000 matters writes nothing; real import resumable. [type:integration]

deliverables.change: New pure parseMigrationCsv(text, mapping): header-to-field mapping, max 5,000 rows, per-row issue codes (missing title, bad date, unknown forum, etc.), no row content in issues.

startMigrationRun (dry_run writes only migration_run/migration_run_row and report; import mode stores pending rows), runMigrationChunk/resumeMigrationRun (250 rows per chunk from resume_from, each chunk an import batch via buildPlanFromDrafts + applyImportPlan, row states and counters advanced in the same transaction, idempotent on retry), getMigrationProgress, rollbackMigrationRun (undoImportBatch per chunk batch, rows to rolled_back, rolled_back_at set, refuse past the 7-day window).
Domain public index exporting the above; not re-exported from the package root.
Add the './migration' subpath export next to './import'.
Add migration to CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES (import, matter-graph, and workspaces/audit only if used); keep the map acyclic.

Integration tests: 5,000-row dry-run leaves matter, proceeding and import_batch counts unchanged and reports mapping issues; import interrupted after N chunks and resumed ends with exactly the expected matters and no duplicates; rollback reverses; another workspace cannot read or run it.
Add a 'migrations' staff capability for the roles that run onboarding (ops/admin); update roles test expectations.
Add the Migrations nav entry and its href to the route union.
Audited staffCall/staffQuery reads: list runs for a workspace, run progress and report.
Server page: pick workspace, upload CSV, column mapping, list runs; counts and issue codes only, no matter content.
Run detail: dry-run report, progress, resume and rollback controls.
'use server' actions: startDryRun, startImport, resumeRun, rollbackRun; requireStaff('migrations'), staff-audited, run as the workspace owner actor.
Register the four new actions in ACTIONS with success-path invocations.
Page render and gating test (role without capability is denied; no row content rendered).

preserve.what: applyImportPlan, undoImportBatch, createImportBatch signatures and behaviour in packages/core/src/import (used by apps/web and jobs).
The enterprise schema and migrations from #682 (packages/db/src/schema/enterprise.ts): no table or column change; the registry/RLS tests stay green.
The admin guard tests (server-actions-audit, no-content-fields, server-component-imports, no-without-workspace-outside-data): admin never value-imports @causedeck/db outside lib/data.
packages/core/src/index.ts root exports: the migration domain is reached only as @causedeck/core/migration.

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/migration src/domains.test.ts src/import/__tests__/apply-import-plan.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/config exec vitest run test/core-domain-boundaries.test.ts test/eslint-boundaries.test.ts

decisions.choice: Run writes execute through core services as the workspace owner actor, with the staff id audited, because staff support sessions are view/usage only.
decisions.justification: packages/core/src/support/sessions.ts:129-137 (no write scope); precedent for staff actions calling core services that audit with actor kind staff: apps/admin/app/(console)/workspaces/[id]/actions.ts

decisions.choice: Each 250-row chunk is its own import batch applied with applyImportPlan, so rollback reuses undoImportBatch and resume is chunk-granular.
decisions.justification: apply.ts:122 applies one whole batch in one transaction and is idempotent by plan hash; undo.ts:33 reverses one batch; the issue names undoImportBatch for rollback.

decisions.choice: New core domain 'migration' reached as a subpath, not a root export, so no cross-tenant SERVICE_TESTS registry entry is needed.
decisions.justification: packages/core/package.json:19 pattern for import; packages/core/src/domains.test.ts root-index rule
